Definition: from G3761 and G4452; not even yet:--as yet not, never before (yet), (not) yet.
BiblicalUsage: Not yet is the word of the interval. The Holy Ghost was not yet fallen upon any of the Samaritans, and John says the Holy Ghost was not yet given, because Jesus was not yet glorified.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the waiting is part of the plan: the Spirit had not yet been given because Jesus was not yet glorified.
